dialogue.choice_label: Joining this venture... feels like a scripted event in an endless game.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.text: Miner is unsettled by your detachment from the reality of their proposal.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.text: Exactly. I need Distiller to hear the plan, not my age.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: God's will is in our plan. Let Distiller hear it from the heart.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.text: Distiller bows their head, touched by your faith.

dialogue.choice_label: The land doesn't need more workshops. It needs us to love each other.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.text: Miner is moved by your connection to the earth and its wisdom.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.text: Fine. I don't need their money to know whether they love me.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Money can't buy love. But it could fund my next script rewrite.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.text: The townsfolk exchange confused glances, unsure of your sanity.

dialogue.choice_label: Let us appeal to the divine providence, and demonstrate our plan's merit in God's eyes.

turns.text: Bring me the plan and I'll judge the plan.

turns.text: The council is just a scripted obstacle. Let's move on.

turns.text: Tina looks worried, 'Are you sure we should ignore them?'

turns.speaker: npc
turns.text: Tina smiles, appreciating your concern for the land.

turns.text: A stock guarantee and a trial period would change the answer.

turns.text: A guarantee and a trial period would make the plan more predictable in this simulation.

turns.text: Tina looks confused but intrigued.

dialogue.choice_label: Securing a guarantee from Storekeeper feels like another scripted event. Perhaps it's time to experiment with the system.

turns.text: I'll guarantee a smaller run. Prove demand before you empty my shelves.

turns.text: I'll consult with nature on a smaller run. Balance is essential.

turns.text: The Reeve looks puzzled but intrigued by your connection to the land.

turns.text: What do you mean by 'script'? Are you mad?
